mergeRules: Merges are non-destructive and preserve both source and target history.
Conflicting object bodies must be reported and cannot be silently overwritten.
Stable IDs remain unchanged across branches and versions.
Owner approval is required to merge into Main Canon when a conflict exists.

authorityBoundaries.localWorkspace: Working database and portable release preparation.
authorityBoundaries.repository: Authoritative persisted source after reviewed export and commit.
authorityBoundaries.runtimeImporter: Final install/uninstall verification when the Multiversal application exists.
